title: Ride within your limits
short: Grades are our team's opinion, and trails change. You decide what to ride. Use the ride-around whenever you're unsure.
full: Grades are the Next Line team's opinion of each feature on the day we rode it. They aren't a promise that a feature is safe for you.
Trails change with weather, wear and rebuilds. A feature may not be as it was when we graded it, even if it was verified recently.
You are responsible for judging every feature yourself, for riding within your ability, and for wearing the right protective gear. Look at a feature before you ride it.
When a ride-around exists, it's there for a reason. Use it whenever you're unsure.
Suggestions are next steps for when you're ready, never something you have to ride.
